name: C.C.P. Contact Probes Co., Ltd.
summary: C.C.P. Contact Probes Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing, processing, purchasing, selling, importing, and exporting of probes and testing stations in Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. The company offers testing solutions, including IC test probes, general final test, battery probes, high-frequency, memory, fine pitch connector, ICT, wafer level, high voltage IC, Kelvin contact, burn-in, ATE connecting, and panel test solutions.
